texts: mixed: the unknown is in the right slot (the bones' position), but the query is over-constrained and reaches only one of the ways a position gets stored. It demands a stored possession link between the bones and the graveyard, which only exists if the fact was also written as a genitive, and it asks only for containment ('in/at/inside'), so a text saying the bones lie beneath the chapel or beside the yew, or giving the place only on the burial event, returns nothing. State the tie as containment and ask the position plainly: "Where do the bones in the old graveyard lie?" - and if the answer you expect uses a non-containment preposition, ask with that word instead, e.g. "What do the bones in the old graveyard lie beneath?"
